content_document_page_key_ck.name: content_document_page_key_ck
content_document_page_key_ck.value: ("content_document"."kind" = 'page' and "content_document"."page_key" in ('clan', 'community', 'privacy', 'faq')) or ("content_document"."kind" in ('news', 'manual') and "content_document"."page_key" is null)

content_translation_live_state_ck.name: content_translation_live_state_ck
content_translation_live_state_ck.value: ("content_translation"."published_revision_id" is null and "content_translation"."live_slug" is null) or ("content_translation"."published_revision_id" is not null and "content_translation"."live_slug" is not null and "content_translation"."published_at" is not null)

publication_schedule_delegation_ck.name: publication_schedule_delegation_ck
publication_schedule_delegation_ck.value: "publication_schedule"."issuer_kind" <> 'local_admin' or ("publication_schedule"."issuer_grant_id" is not null and "publication_schedule"."issuer_grant_version" is not null)

match_result_scores_ck.name: match_result_scores_ck
match_result_scores_ck.value: ("match_result"."score_valkyria" is null and "match_result"."score_opponent" is null) or ("match_result"."score_valkyria" is not null and "match_result"."score_opponent" is not null and "match_result"."score_valkyria" >= 0 and "match_result"."score_opponent" >= 0)

match_round_scores_ck.name: match_round_scores_ck
match_round_scores_ck.value: ("match_round"."score_valkyria" is null or "match_round"."score_valkyria" >= 0) and ("match_round"."score_opponent" is null or "match_round"."score_opponent" >= 0)

match_statistics_result_ck.name: match_statistics_result_ck
match_statistics_result_ck.value: ("match_statistics"."result_allied" is null and "match_statistics"."result_axis" is null) or ("match_statistics"."result_allied" between 0 and 5 and "match_statistics"."result_axis" between 0 and 5)

member_profile_consent_ck.name: member_profile_consent_ck
member_profile_consent_ck.value: "member_profile"."state" <> 'published' or ("member_profile"."consent_confirmed_at" is not null and "member_profile"."published_at" is not null)

tournament_dates_ck.name: tournament_dates_ck
tournament_dates_ck.value: "tournament"."starts_on" is null or "tournament"."ends_on" is null or "tournament"."ends_on" >= "tournament"."starts_on"
